- The user supplied the full original memoir article. All prose in the book proof is a proposed revision for author review, not approved for unrestricted publication.
- Art plates in this prototype use **cropped/upscaled details from AI-generated visual concept boards** already present in the conversation. They are derivative layout proofs, **not independent high-resolution master paintings**. Future professional repaint/layered master is pending.
- The white fluffy Gấu and Jason's beanie/all-black look are deliberate poster art directions. The dream in the original narrative describes a solitary walk; the dog is an imaginative visual addition.
- Do not copy external album artwork, Soviet photographs, game art, game soundtrack, official logos, or voice of any real person without applicable permission.
- Verify attributed Call of Duty dialogue and chapter history before commercial publication. Game/video content is narrated subjectively, not as a war documentary.
- Ambient audio in the animatic is newly synthesized in Python with no third-party song. No voiceover was recorded. Visual-beat captions are not synced to actual narration.
- Do not publish full original drafts to the public repository until explicit author release approval. Printer PDF/X, QR, social account uploads and live site checks remain incomplete.
